reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: handleConsent has a live caller (consent-form.tsx uses it as a form action). Gate 2: BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json defines no trust_assumptions; attack vector is an external attacker with no trusted-source exemption. Gate 3: src/app/oauth/ is explicitly in scope. Code confirms the finding: actions.ts L19 reads redirect_uri from formData and passes it directly to create_authorization_code (L86) with no isValidRedirectUri check, while the guard at route.ts:94 is bypassed by direct navigation to /oauth/authorize/consent. An attacker can trigger this via direct GET to /oauth/authorize/consent with an arbitrary redirect_uri query parameter by social-engineering a logged-in victim to approve the crafted consent form, causing the auth code to be issued to https://evil.com/steal and — since the attacker also controls the PKCE code_verifier — the code can be immediately exchanged for a valid access token. Severity remains Medium (user interaction required); manual review for upgrade to High is recommended given PKCE provides no mitigation here.
